analysis_scope: BUSI error analysis; lesion-positive cases for size groups and normal cases for false positives
size_group_rule: tertiles of ground-truth lesion area fraction across the 91 positive test groups
fp_fn_derivation: For binary positive masks, intersection = Dice*(GT area + prediction area)/2; FP = prediction area - intersection; FN = GT area - intersection.

candidate_rules.large_e2_drop: E1 mean Dice - E2 mean Dice >= 0.10
candidate_rules.e1_good_e2_poor: E1 mean Dice >= 0.70 and E2 mean Dice < 0.60

important_limit: Size groups and derived FP/FN are currently quantitative for BUSI only; Synapse and ACDC remain qualitative error analyses until mask-level grouping is added.
